name: ResearchLoop::step
logic_name: Bounded experiment orchestration with exact-path capability attenuation and acknowledged mutation receipts

test_list.description: Reserve before execution, parse a successful bounded metric, request keep, require a distinct VCS receipt, and persist the settled iteration.
Ties and regressions invoke the real workspace revert seam and never advance the best baseline.
A tool call requesting a path different from its declared scoped path receives an exact-path attenuated token and is denied before execution.
Failed process or malformed output triggers recovery and cannot be counted as a successful measurement.
A reopened in-flight checkpoint requires actual baseline restoration and a durable recovery receipt before another experiment.
No additional runner invocation occurs after experiment, wall, token, cost, or plateau bound.

inputs.name: reservation
inputs.description: Worst-case resource reservation recorded before sandbox execution.

output_description: One bounded experiment result with measured evidence and acknowledged keep/revert or explicit recovery status.
